name: Nest Playgate
description: A curated kid catalog and a parent gate that closes. Children ask from a fixed roster; a parent grants or refuses with a reason, either way, into an append-only log; a grant verifies the APK's digest and installs it into Waydroid, recording the outcome including failure. Every catalog entry carries an interruption record — how often the app stops the child — with a provenance state of assumed, fitted or measured, and no composite score anywhere.
author: USER

data_streams.purpose: Append-only disposition log: who asked, for what, who answered, why, and what the interruption evidence looked like at that moment
data_streams.retention: until the operator deletes the log file; nothing here is rotated, compacted, or rewritten by the app
data_streams.description: One JSONL file on the operator's machine. Rows are appended and never edited: a correction is a new row beside the old one, so the log can be used to check whether a decision was reasonable on the evidence available at the time, not only whether it turned out well.

network: loopback listener only. Binds 127.0.0.1 to serve the kid and parent UIs to a browser on the same machine, and serve() refuses any non-loopback bind. No outbound requests of any kind: no catalog fetch, no update check, no telemetry, and no report of what a child asked for leaving the machine. Verified structurally by tests/test_no_egress.py, which scans the core for network imports at all and scans server.py for outbound clients specifically.

dev_server.note: Start with: python -m playgate serve --subject kid1

notes.subprocess: Grants shell out to `adb install` against a running Waydroid session. That is a real capability and it is the only one: the app never downloads an APK. It verifies the SHA256 of a file an operator already placed on disk, and refuses outright when no digest is recorded.
notes.no_score: The catalog view exposes four unweighted interruption facts — count per ten minutes, how the interruption ends, the date observed, the provenance state — and deliberately no composite. A single displayed number would be built from weights somebody picked, sorted on, and within two releases optimised against, measuring compliance with the scoring function rather than interruption.
notes.shipped_catalog_is_all_assumed: Nobody has measured any entry in data/catalog.json, so every entry reads `assumed`, and a test enforces that. Reaching `measured` requires ten minutes, a child, and someone watching; there is no code path that can produce it.
notes.ci_blind_spots: The store floor's vault_leak_lint and the drift-guard suites glob *.py and now have Python to read here, so this app is no longer UNKNOWN to them. What no suite in this repo can see: whether Waydroid actually installs anything. The adb path is exercised against an injected runner and against a genuinely absent adb on the CI runner, never against a real device.
notes.web_is_out_of_scope: This gates installed packages. It has nothing to say about a browser tab, which is where the problem it answers usually starts. It is a supply-side fix: it makes the good path good enough to use, and says nothing about the bad one.
notes.relation_to_nest: An earlier prototype of this host lived outside version control, on the author's own machine. This is a rebuild against the store's conventions, not a copy of it; the two will diverge and this one is the one under CI.
notes.persistence: Everything this app writes resolves through libs/vault-paths (installer design D8) — the disposition log and the operator's APK directory both land under the vault, never in a home path and never in the app's own install directory. PLAYGATE_LOG and PLAYGATE_APK_DIR override. Only playgate/paths.py imports the resolver, and tests/test_paths.py enforces that.
